    ⊢
      ∀ Φ,
        isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc ∗
            typedPointsto

                  go!"ReadView" s)
                (interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.readView.ty.PointerType (intoVal rv))
                DFrac.discard ∗
              mvcc.isReadView rv s γ ∗ mvcc.storeReader s γ ∗ ownToks γ.revs m ∗ mvcc.idxCert γ.idx log₀ -∗
          (▷
              ∀ v,
                (mvcc.storeReader s γ ∗
                    ownToks γ.revs m ∗
                      ∃ log,
                        mvcc.idxCert γ.idx log ∗
                          ⌜log₀ <+: log ∧
                              List.length log + m + 3 ≤ 2 ^ 63 ∧ log ≠ [] ∧ v = W64 (↑(List.length log) - 1)⌝) -∗
                  Φ (intoVal v)) -∗
            WP
              ((intoVal
                  (methods go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store.ty.PointerType go!"Rev" (intoVal s)))
                (intoVal ()))
              {{ Φ }}

def mvcc.storeTxnWrite.End.specR : Prop :=
  ∀ (trace tw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (chs : GoSlice) (ps : List Loc)
    (sealed : Bool) (P : IProp GF) (f : val) (crev : Int),
    ⊢
      ∀ Φ,
        isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc ∗
            mvcc.storeTxnWriteCore tw s γ trace ilog pend chs ps sealed crev ∗
              mvcc.hookIs γ P f ∗ P ∗ mvcc.certOkNext γ ilog pend ∗ mvcc.logQPre γ ilog pend -∗
          ▷
              (mvcc.storeReader s γ ∗
                  mvcc.idxCert γ.idx (mvcc.commitLog ilog pend) ∗
                    (if pend = [] then mvcc.revToken γ else True) ∗
                      mvcc.logQPost γ ilog pend ∗ mvcc.writerFrag γ ∗ mvcc.writerPin γ (mvcc.commitLog ilog pend) -∗
                Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
            WP
              ((intoVal
                  (methods go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.storeTxnWrite.ty.PointerType go!"End"
                    (intoVal tw)))
                (intoVal ()))
              {{ Φ }}

def mvcc.storeTxnWrite.Range.specR : Prop :=
  ∀ (trace tw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (ctx : GoInterfaceOk)
    (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) (todo : Bool) (key endk : GoSlice) (k e : GoString)
    (ro : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.RangeOptions) (te : Bool) (crev : Int),
    ⊢
      ∀ Φ,
        isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc ∗
            mvcc.storeTxnWriteIs tw s γ trace ilog pend crev ∗
              mvcc.rangeCtx todo ctx cd ∗
                ownSlice key k DFrac.discard ∗ ownSlice endk e DFrac.discard ∗ traceutil.ownTrace trace te -∗
          (▷
              ∀ r err,
                ⌜todo = true → r ≠ null⌝ ∗
                    mvcc.storeTxnWriteIs tw s γ trace ilog pend crev ∗
                      traceutil.ownTrace trace te ∗
                        mvcc.rangeOutcomeC r err (ilog ++ [pend]) (W64 ↑(mvcc.writeRev ilog pend)) crev
                          (decide (endk = slice.nil)) k e ro -∗
                  Φ (intoVal r, intoVal err)) -∗
            WP
              (((((intoVal
                        (methods go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.storeTxnWrite.ty.PointerType
                          go!"Range" (intoVal tw)))
                      (intoVal (GoInterface.ok ctx)))
                    (intoVal key))
                  (intoVal endk))
                (intoVal ro))
              {{ Φ }}
